summary.name: Franz
summary.one_liner: Franz is a desktop messaging app that combines many chat and email services, such as WhatsApp, Slack, Telegram, Gmail, and Signal, into one window.
use_cases: Keep client WhatsApp chats, team Slack, and email in one window
Get unified notifications across several chat services
Manage multiple messaging accounts without switching apps
Run a website as a custom service alongside chat apps
summary.what_it_does: Franz is a desktop app that puts many messaging and email services in one working view. The page lists over 75 supported services, including WhatsApp, Slack, Gmail, Signal, Discord, and Telegram. Each service runs in its own isolated container. Notifications and unread badges are unified across all services. Users can also add any website as a custom service. The meta description additionally mentions Outlook, native Signal, AI summaries, workspaces, and local privacy features.
notable: Each service runs in an isolated container
Unified notifications and unread badges across services
Any website can be added as a custom service
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page text; the awesome-mac listing marks it as freeware, which is a listing label rather than a page fact
